_about: Curated seed for the §VIII compose-time retraction net.
Each REAL entry was ground-truthed against Crossref / Retraction Watch
(see notice_url). The registry keys on the ORIGINAL paper's DOI/PMID —
the identifier a researcher actually cites — because Crossref's structured
is_retracted flag is FALSE on these originals (they carry only a title-prefix
'RETRACTED:' notice), so without this local seed they would slip the net.
Operators extend/replace this set via load_registry_from_yaml().
The two 99000001 / 99000002 synthetic fixtures are retained ONLY because
existing tests exercise the scanner against deterministic placeholders.
